reason: The text depicts the opposite of discouragement from expressing views. Multiple instances show Hebrews actively voicing concerns: Judah explicitly states the building difficulties ('כָּשַׁל כֹּ֣חַ הַסַּבָּ֔ל - the strength of the burden-bearers is decayed'); Jews living nearby report threats multiple times to the leadership; and Nehemiah directly exhorts the leaders, rulers, and people to express their resolve through action, saying 'אַל־ תִּֽירְא֖וּ - be not afraid' and commanding them to 'הִֽלָּחֲמ֗וּ - fight for your brethren.' The passage demonstrates active encouragement of civic participation and expression of concerns, with leadership actively listening and responding to reported difficulties.
